languagePrep.title: German becomes a clear progression
languagePrep.body: Build the language level, take the right exam, then move toward the academic route that fits your profile.

A1.label: A1 · Breakthrough
A1.canDo: Understands and uses familiar everyday expressions and very basic phrases; can introduce themselves, share basic personal details, and communicate simply when the other person speaks slowly and clearly.

A2.label: A2 · Elementary
A2.canDo: Understands frequently used sentences and expressions about immediate needs; can handle simple routine exchanges and describe their background and surroundings in simple terms.

B1.label: B1 · Intermediate
B1.canDo: Understands the main points of clear standard language on familiar matters; can handle most travel situations and produce connected language about experiences and plans.

B2.label: B2 · Upper intermediate
B2.canDo: Understands the main ideas of complex texts, including discussions in their field; can interact with greater fluency and explain viewpoints clearly and in detail.

C1.label: C1 · Advanced / Academic
C1.canDo: Understands a wide range of demanding longer texts and implicit meaning; can use language fluently and flexibly for social, academic, and professional purposes.

languagePrep.levelMeaningLabel: What you can do at this level
languagePrep.cefrNote: The Council of Europe reference levels describe language ability. Each school or institution sets the level it requires.

telc.label: telc · Registration support
telc.description: We can help you choose a suitable telc exam, coordinate the registration process and prepare the documents you need.
telc.verifiedDescription: A CEFR C1 examination focused on the German needed in academic and university contexts.
telc.caveat: Recognition is governed by the higher-education framework; always confirm the exact requirement with the target university.

TestDaF.label: TestDaF · Registration support
TestDaF.description: We can help you plan your TestDaF route, coordinate registration with the relevant centre and prepare for the exam stage.
TestDaF.verifiedDescription: A standardized German exam for prospective international students. Results are reported separately for each skill on the TDN 3–5 scale.
TestDaF.caveat: TDN 4 in all four sections meets the general framework requirement, but a university or program may set stricter conditions.

TestAS.label: TestAS · Registration support
TestAS.description: We can help you understand when TestAS is relevant, coordinate the registration steps and prepare your application timeline.
TestAS.verifiedDescription: A standardized aptitude test measuring general and subject-related skills for international university applicants. It is not a language exam.
TestAS.caveat: It may support or be required for an application, depending entirely on the individual university.

onSET.label: onSET · Language assessment
onSET.description: We can guide you on using onSET as a language-level assessment when it fits your route and explain the next step.

DSH.label: DSH · University entrance exam
DSH.description: We can explain when DSH preparation may fit your university route and help you plan the registration steps with the relevant institution.
DSH.verifiedDescription: A German university-entrance language examination administered by individual universities and Studienkollegs under a shared framework.
DSH.caveat: DSH-2 is the general unrestricted benchmark, but administration and additional conditions can differ by institution.

Goethe.label: Goethe-Zertifikat · Language certificate
Goethe.description: We can help you identify the level you need, compare suitable options and plan the certificate stage.
Goethe.verifiedDescription: The Goethe-Institut offers German-language examinations from A1 to C2, including advanced C1 and C2 certificates.
Goethe.caveat: Acceptance for admission depends on the university, Studienkolleg, and program; confirm before registering.

IELTS.label: IELTS · English language test
IELTS.description: We can help you understand when an English certificate is relevant to your route and organize the next steps.

TOEFL.label: TOEFL · English language test
TOEFL.description: We can help you check whether TOEFL fits the requirement and plan the test stage within your application timeline.
